findings.description: Both emitted persona briefs and all five generated native persona wrappers instruct agents to read SKILL.md before presenting the read rule and Codex command. This violates the required ordering and permits a shortened prefix to deliver a read instruction without its guard. Move the preamble before the installed-path guidance and test ordering against the first instruction.

All five generated Claude effort wrappers omit the read rule and Codex command, despite requiring agents to follow skill reads. The intent requires every native wrapper to carry the preamble before other instructions. Include these wrappers in generation and acceptance coverage.
